subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a powerful sunblade that can read and write, and can cast lesser restoration.
source_quote: The sword introduces itself as Dawnbringer. A powerful sunblade that can read and write, and can cast lesser restoration.

subject: necklace of fireballs
fact: The necklace of fireballs is a treasure found inside an invisible chest.
source_quote: Inside, we find even more treasure: a necklace of fireballs, a potion of greater healing, and some gold.

subject: potion of greater healing
fact: The potion of greater healing is a treasure found inside an invisible chest.
source_quote: Inside, we find even more treasure: a necklace of fireballs, a potion of greater healing, and some gold.

subject: scroll of protection against fiends
fact: The scroll of protection against fiends is contained within a moldy scroll case given by Basidia.
source_quote: They hands us a moldy scroll case, and inside is a scroll containing a scroll of protection against fiends.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: Neverlight Grove is a vast cavern with bioluminescent walls, glowing myconids, and a central basin containing a clear pool and a giant mushroom visible in the distance.
source_quote: As we enter the cave, the beauty overwhelms Grygum, who shouts, “Wow, this place is incredible.” ... The cave walls shimmer with a soft, bioluminescent light, casting a gentle glow on everything. The light is a beautiful mosaic of blues, greens, and purples, like a nebula trapped underground. ... A central mound is the only dry spot in sight, though a small cliff rises above the cavern floor far across the clearing with giant mushrooms visible in the distance.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The Garden of Welcome is a forbidden area where the Circle of the Masters prepares a wondrous and glorious surprise, and where previous 'softers' have disappeared.
source_quote: Please, don’t visit the eastern plateau because the Circle of the Masters is preparing a wondrous and glorious surprise in the Garden of Welcome. ... Another group of 'softers' arrived not too many cycles ago and accepted Phylo’s offer. They were taken to the Garden of Welcome. I haven’t seen them since, nor has Phylo made any further mention of them.

subject: Circle of Masters
fact: The Circle of Masters is a group of myconids closest to Phylo who reanimate dead creatures and send myconids outside the grove without explanation.
source_quote: The Circle of Masters is a circle of those who are closest to Phylo. ... The Circle of Masters is taking most of the carcasses the Circle of Hunters bring in, and are sending groups of myconids outside the grove without telling anybody.

subject: Circle of Hunters
fact: The Circle of Hunters is a myconid circle responsible for bringing back dead creatures to the Circle of Masters for reanimation.
source_quote: Loobamub. ... Phylo insists that all dead creatures must be brought to the Circle of Masters. ... We bring back the dead. We do not kill.

subject: Inner Circle
fact: The Inner Circle consists of all circle leaders and is separate from the Circle of Masters, though both are part of Phylo’s new social order.
source_quote: Phylo decided that each circle would meld exclusively with its circle, and only the circle leaders would meld with other circle leaders and the sovereigns. ... The Inner Circle of all of the circle leaders and the Circle of Masters is a circle of those who are closest to Phylo.

subject: Phylo
fact: Phylo is a myconid sovereign who has imposed a new social order on Neverlight Grove, isolating circles and aligning with the Circle of Masters, and may be infected by a diseased spore.
source_quote: The creature introduces itself as Phylo and is genuinely happy to see us. ... Phylo decided that each circle would meld exclusively with its circle... I fear Phylo has contracted some kind of diseased spore.

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia is a myconid sovereign who opposes Phylo’s new social order and secretly warns outsiders of the dangers in the Garden of Welcome and the Circle of Masters.
source_quote: The other sovereign introduces itself as Basidia and says to Phylo, “I can take them on the tour of the gardens, co-sovereign.” ... I do not recognize the spores of this drow. ... I believe this is contrary to the unity and harmony of our way of life.

subject: Loobamub
fact: Loobamub is the leader of the Circle of Hunters who brings dead creatures to the Circle of Masters for reanimation and requests help to deal with a grick.
source_quote: Loobamub. ... Loobamub listens to Basidia, and then he turns to me and asks if we could help him deal with a grick. ... Phylo insists that all dead creatures must be brought to the Circle of Masters.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a drow guide who has been infected by Zuggtomy’s demonic spores, which Basidia recognizes as unnatural.
source_quote: I do not recognize the spores of this drow. ... Poor Sarith has been affected by Zuggtomy.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a compassionate member of the party who insists on keeping Dawnbringer lit at night, despite others wanting to sleep.
source_quote: Thorin, who is too compassionate, would keep it lit, even at night, when many of us wanted to sleep.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is an orc who expresses nostalgia for a talking mace and is disturbed by reanimated creatures and the idea of zombie gricks.
source_quote: A talking mace would have been nice." ... Grygum looks uncomfortable, I turn to him and say - “What, you don't want a zombie grick joining our team? That sounds so fun.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a cautious member of the party who uses an orb of darkness, fears mushroom-related zombie diseases, and is skeptical of Phylo’s changes.
source_quote: Zalthir, who finds the idea of mushrooms that turn you into zombies very creepy, covers himself in his orb of darkness and hangs back.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a knowledgeable observer who recognizes the signs of Zuggtomy’s influence, understands Menzoberranzan’s political metaphors, and uses Shape Water to detect hidden threats.
source_quote: Daz turns to me, “How odd. Myconids have no gender... The sovereign’s use of a specific gender... is quite peculiar.” ... I have seen this before. There is no mystery what this diseased spore is, its power." ... I visualize the terrain as a precise grid, and intend to freeze five-foot cube sections of the moss and water using Shape Water.

subject: Myconids
fact: The myconids are sentient fungal beings who live in Neverlight Grove, organized into circles, and are now divided by Phylo’s new social order.
source_quote: Myconids, the mushroom folk we're traveling with, are everywhere, and they seem to be a part of this vibrant world... Each circle gathers around a circle mound... Phylo decided that each circle would meld exclusively with its circle...

subject: Circle of the Masters
fact: The Circle of the Masters is a myconid faction that reanimates corpses, removes members from the grove, and is suspected of being corrupted by demonic spores.
source_quote: The Circle of Masters is taking most of the carcasses the Circle of Hunters bring in, and are sending groups of myconids outside the grove without telling anybody.

subject: arrival at Neverlight Grove
fact: The party arrives at Neverlight Grove after traversing the Underdark, and is awed by its bioluminescent beauty, only to discover its hidden dangers and political fractures.
source_quote: Today, we arrive at Neverlight Grove. ... As we enter the cave, the beauty overwhelms Grygum, who shouts, “Wow, this place is incredible.” ... Basidia warns us the grove is not safe.

subject: discovery of the invisible chest
fact: The party discovers an invisible chest in the false tomb and retrieves a necklace of fireballs, a potion of greater healing, and gold.
source_quote: As we look around for treasure, we stumble on an invisible chest. Using fairy fire, I outline the box, and Zalthir opens it. Inside, we find even more treasure: a necklace of fireballs, a potion of greater healing, and some gold.

subject: Basidia’s warning about the Garden of Welcome
fact: Basidia reveals that previous visitors taken to the Garden of Welcome have vanished and that the Circle of Masters is sending myconids out of the grove without consent.
source_quote: Another group of 'softers' arrived not too many cycles ago and accepted Phylo’s offer. They were taken to the Garden of Welcome. I haven’t seen them since, nor has Phylo made any further mention of them.

subject: recognition of Sarith’s infected spores
fact: Basidia identifies Sarith’s spores as unnatural and different from those of other myconid sovereigns, indicating Zuggtomy’s influence.
source_quote: I do not recognize the spores of this drow. ... Poor Sarith has been affected by Zuggtomy.

subject: offer of the scroll of protection against fiends
fact: Basidia gives the party a moldy scroll case containing a scroll of protection against fiends as a token of trust and a tool for confronting the corruption in the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: They hands us a moldy scroll case, and inside is a scroll containing a scroll of protection against fiends.

subject: request to hunt the grick
fact: Loobamub asks the party to retrieve a grick for reanimation by Basidia, revealing the myconids’ role as collectors, not killers.
source_quote: Loobamub listens to Basidia, and then he turns to me and asks if we could help him deal with a grick. ... We bring back the dead. We do not kill.

subject: use of K’tharr-li to detect the shambling mound
fact: Daz applies the childhood game K’tharr-li to detect the hidden shambling mound by freezing terrain in five-foot cubes to reveal anomalies.
source_quote: I visualize the terrain as a precise grid, and intend to freeze five-foot cube sections of the moss and water using Shape Water. ... When I was a child, there was a game we played called K’tharr-li.

subject: access tunnel to Neverlight Grove
fact: The access tunnel to Neverlight Grove is a natural formation created by a drying underground stream, dimly lit by lichen, and opens above the grove’s main floor.
source_quote: We have just entered this magical place from a natural tunnel that was formed by a drying underground stream, and that is dimly lit by lichen. The access tunnel opens above the grove’s main floor.

subject: central basin of Neverlight Grove
fact: The central basin of Neverlight Grove contains a clear pool, a dry central mound, and is surrounded by a fungal forest covering every surface including the ceiling.
source_quote: Beyond the mud and mushrooms of the fungal forest, a large, clear pool sits in the midst of the fungal grove. A central mound is the only dry spot in sight...

subject: eastern plateau
fact: The eastern plateau is a forbidden zone where the Circle of Masters prepares a mysterious and glorious surprise, and where visitors vanish.
source_quote: Please, don’t visit the eastern plateau because the Circle of the Masters is preparing a wondrous and glorious surprise in the Garden of Welcome.

subject: ravine beyond Neverlight Grove
fact: The ravine beyond Neverlight Grove narrows the cavern and is shrouded in mist, with smaller caverns visible beyond.
source_quote: Beyond the exotic forest, the cavern narrows into a ravine. And beyond the ravine, I catch a glimpse of a majestic mushroom... the darkness of the ravine and mist-shrouded smaller cavern beyond.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The Garden of Welcome is a sacred yet dangerous site where the Circle of Masters performs unknown rites, and where those who enter do not return.
source_quote: The Circle of the Masters is preparing a wondrous and glorious surprise in the Garden of Welcome. ... I haven’t seen them since, nor has Phylo made any further mention of them.

subject: Phylo’s imposition of new social order
fact: Phylo has restructured the myconid society to isolate circles and restrict melding to only circle leaders and sovereigns, causing division and fear.
source_quote: Phylo decided that each circle would meld exclusively with its circle, and only the circle leaders would meld with other circle leaders and the sovereigns. Phylo said that everything would be more efficient and better.

subject: Basidia’s offer of potions
fact: Basidia offers to brew potions of various potency if the party helps uncover the truth behind Phylo’s corruption.
source_quote: I can also brew many potions of various potency.

subject: Rump-a-dump
fact: Rump-a-dump is a myconid who shouts “We’re home!” upon entering Neverlight Grove, showing deep familiarity with the grove.
source_quote: And then I hear Rump-a-dump's delight and Stool’s happiness as they run into the cavern shouting, “We’re home!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a myconid who celebrates returning to Neverlight Grove and speaks highly of Zalthir and Thorin’s kindness.
source_quote: Stool interrupts the creature to explain how Thorin carried him when he was tired, and that Zalthir was always grouchy but a really nice softer, and saved Rump-a-dump.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a myconid who smiles at Grygum and reminds him of a bet, then races after the other myconids.
source_quote: Jimjar smiles at me and says, “Remember my bet,” as he races after the two myconids and Sarith.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is a goblin who reports that the party’s pursuers have been lost and are no longer on their trail.
source_quote: Eldeth told us this morning that she believed we had lost them. They were no longer on our trail.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot warned the party that the tomb they entered was a false one, complete with an easily opened sarcophagus.
source_quote: This was the place that Fargas Rumblefoot warned us of.

subject: Zuggtomy
fact: Zuggtomy is a deity associated with fungal corruption and is suspected of infecting Sarith and possibly Phylo with demonic spores.
source_quote: Poor Sarith has been affected by Zuggtomy. ... I remember that Zuggtomy is often referred to as she.

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a group of companions who follow Daz’s plan to use Shape Water to detect the shambling mound.
source_quote: I tell The Ember Vanguard that I have a plan to neutralize the creature’s ability to hide.

subject: reanimation of corpses by the Circle of Masters
fact: The Circle of Masters reanimates dead creatures brought by the Circle of Hunters, turning them into tools or weapons.
source_quote: Phylo insists that all dead creatures must be brought to the Circle of Masters. ... To reanimate.

subject: Phylo’s declaration of a day of joy
fact: Phylo declares that Neverlight Grove is on the verge of something great, and urges celebration as the day of joy is nigh.
source_quote: You arrive at a wondrous time, for Neverlight Grove is on the verge of something great, something marvelous! Celebrate as the day of joy is nigh!

subject: Basidia’s whispered warning
fact: Basidia whispers her fears directly into the party’s minds, revealing that Phylo’s changes are unnatural and dangerous.
source_quote: Basidia then whispers, even though we can only hear her in our heads, “the Circle of Masters is taking most of the carcasses the Circle of Hunters bring in, and are sending groups of myconids outside the grove without telling anybody.”

subject: mound of the Circle of Hunters
fact: The mound of the Circle of Hunters is a pile of rocks and soil where Loobamub and his circle gather to sleep and prepare dead creatures for the Circle of Masters.
source_quote: Each circle gathers around a circle mound, which they describe as a pile of rocks and soil upon which mold, lichen, and mushrooms grow. ... Loobamub. ... We bring back the dead.

subject: great circle of the Masters
fact: The great circle of the Masters is the central gathering place of the Circle of Masters, where they perform rites and prepare their wondrous and glorious surprise.
source_quote: Phylo said that everything would be more efficient and better. Many of the myconids have followed Phylo and his new ways. ... I shall take them to the great circle of the Masters.

subject: Phylo’s co-sovereign arrangement with Basidia
fact: Phylo and Basidia are co-sovereigns of Neverlight Grove, a power-sharing structure Daz compares to the Menzoberranzan metaphor of 'two in a box' — a tomb of indecision.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, there were tales of two rulers who shared power. We used the term, ‘two in a box’ to describe this power sharing. ... Phylo says, “ You are my sovereign and co-equal in all things.”

subject: The Great Seeder
fact: The Great Seeder is a mysterious entity beyond the Garden of Welcome, whom Phylo claims will help all myconids get closer to her beauty.
source_quote: You should direct your questions to the Great Seeder. ... She lives beyond the Garden. She is a wonderful entity who will help all of us get closer to her beauty!
